summary: Short kerb on a busy junction corner; no cars parked, no room to stop.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked along it
Right at a junction, 15 m only
Road markings and power pole at corner

drivers.seclusion: A house sits 9 m behind the kerb at the corner, and the junction is fully open.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 15 m of kerb, at the mouth of a junction with a painted island and power pole; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Wide through road with a junction and turning traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this stretch; no sign of overnight use.

sun_shade: Open to the sun, with a few small trees on the verge.
cannot_judge: Exact no-stopping rules at the junction
